title: WorkOrderProfile
description: Payload profile for pheromones published with kind=="workOrder" (FR-11.1). phase is a free-form string, not a closed enum — no SDLC phase taxonomy has been established in spec/ yet (see docs/planning/orchestrator-implementation-plan.md §7); reconciling phase against a real taxonomy, if one proves necessary, is deferred to when bridge usage data justifies authoring one.
